title: Lock and Unlock
description: Càng khoá nhấc lên 10 px rồi xoay nghiêng quanh chân trái bằng lò xo, thân khoá đứng yên, chữ ĐÃ KHOÁ đổi thành ĐÃ MỞ; đóng lại thì càng hạ xuống có vạch loé.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-control-lock-unlock, written here): Lock body 72x56 r10 (accent, keyhole). Shackle: U of 8 px stroke (legs 40 px apart, arc r20). Lift 0 → 10 px over 0.35-0.55 s power2.out; then pivot on the left leg to −0.5 rad (−28.6°) on spring k200 c12 from 0.55 s (overshoot). Close: angle back over 1.85-2.05 s power2.in, lift down 2.05-2.17 s power1.in, two click marks flash at the landing (decay e^(−12 t)). Label LOCKED → UNLOCKED crossfades with the opening. Params: lift (10 px) · angle (−28.6°) · spring (k200 c12) · close (1.85 s). The shackle lifts 10 units, then swings on its left leg to −0.5 rad on a spring k200 c12; it closes with two click marks.
